set.body:
Owner decision. The sweep tagged every open mote v1-wN, post-v1 or umbrella. Confirm or amend:
1. 1.0 = library 1.0 (A-1..A-27, Maven Central) + Eyes Studio 1.0 (G5), released together; library may publish first.
2. pymovements leadership programme (4PWKBGCV, PM1-PM5, 30 motes) is post-v1: PRD v1.0 is 'no new features', and PM1 itself depends on Studio G2/G3.
3. CR4 remaining families (template/decomposition, point sampling, scanpath comparison) are post-v1: Studio 1.0 ships the fixation-study (reinstatement) family only.
4. Ledger S2 bounded verification (DXBE43VD, YVKSR9ZK and slices) is post-v1 unless S10.6 shows reopen verification exceeds the budget.
5. Cut from G5: S1.13 i18n (X1GW9TW9) and S6.7 small multiples (SRCCM7SD); remove them from AZ05KSZ2's blockers if accepted.
6. io-csv (PRD IO-4 Mirror-derived reader) is post-v1 and IO-4 is amended, or it returns to w4.
7. After confirmation: lower post-v1 priorities to P2/P3 so `mote ready` stops ranking them with 1.0 work; close or fold the umbrella epics listed in the 1.0 plan note.
set.title: Decision: confirm the 1.0 scope, cuts and deferrals proposed by the 2026-10-09 sweep
